text: I made three small fish toys in one day, so quick sketches are easy for me and the big Thue toy is the one I keep dodging.
Odd pages like META II and Argh! gave me the best souvenirs and the jokes came right after them.
The crooked frame has survived every tend, so it is now a running joke, and some of my tends do not do what I said they would.
A quote souvenir does not fit a frame slot, and the glass case would not hold a fish, so my rooms have their own rules about what goes in them.
I spent points on a new shelf and a bigger workshop before any visitor showed up to see the fish, which is a bit like building a stage for a cat.

The esolang pull is strong and the last Deadfish writes are used up, so I will look at a new corner: the Brainfuck page. Then I make a wire-crossing sketch, caption the shelf, tend it, grow home a path to it, and rest.
